description:
You and your symbiotes exude a spray of poison. You take 1 damage. Roll Spirit vs Fortitude against an Adjacent creature. On a win, it takes 1d12 damage. On a loss, half damage.

Describe the effects of the poison.
name: Poison Spray
successes:
✨: Add HEART to the damage roll.

🌞: Repeat the roll and damage next Round.
